text: You mistakenly ordered a Wireless Earbud with an IPX7 water resistance level, but you don't require this feature. You wish to exchange it for one with the same water resistance level as the other Wireless Earbuds that you've purchased. In fact, you want to exchange it to the cheapest earbud item from the rest of that order.
zh: 您错误地订购了一个具有IPX7防水等级的无线耳机，但您不需要这个功能。您希望将其更换为与您之前购买的无线耳机具有相同防水等级的耳机。实际上，您希望将其更换为该订单中剩余的最便宜耳机商品。（无线耳机 #W1234567，IPX7防水等级）
